purpose: Teach: 捕まっ/のぼる/ウリ/難点/馬車/発熱/今ひとつ/苦い

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、テスト、お前、いいスコア、捕まったよね、本当に、すごいよね、リク、努力、すごいよ、いつも。
lines.en: Riku, that test score — you actually crushed it. Your effort, it's really something else. Always.
lines.style: Warm, genuine praise. Quick rhythm on the lead-in. Slight catch of real feeling when she says 'crushed it.' Not performative. Matter-of-fact admiration.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。富士山にのぼる、夏休み、家族で、計画してるんだ、桜、お前も、いつか、行きたいよな、絶対。
lines.en: Yeah. We're planning to climb Mt. Fuji with my family over summer break. You should come with us sometime, Sakura. I mean it.
lines.style: Soft, tentative opening. Energy lifts on 'climb.' The invitation lands gently — he's testing the water, not pushing. Sincere undercurrent. Ends with quiet conviction.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: うちのクラスの、ウリ、文化祭の出し物、結構、毎年、評判いいのよね、リク、私たち、頑張ろうね、本当に。
lines.en: Our class's main event for the school festival — honestly, we get a really good reputation every year. Let's make this one count too, okay? We've got to try.
lines.style: Animated, fast-paced opening. Pride on 'good reputation.' Shifts slightly firmer on the ask — she's calling him in. Collaborative energy, not demanding.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前の進路選択、難点、何だ?俺、相談、乗るぜ、桜、お前、悩んでること、教えてくれる、いつでも、本当に。
lines.en: What's making the career thing hard for you? I mean it — you can talk to me about what's weighing on you. Anytime.
lines.style: Leans forward with attention. Direct but not pushes. The phrase 'weighing on you' carries gentleness. Ends quietly resolute — he's offering real ground here.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 歴史の授業で、昔の馬車、面白かったよね、リク、昔の人、不思議な生活、してたね、本当に、興味深い、現代と違うね。
lines.en: That history lesson about old carriages was fascinating, right? The way people lived back then — it's so different from now. Kind of mysterious when you really think about it.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly distant opening. Pace slows on 'mysterious.' She's processing aloud, not performing. Genuine curiosity lives in the cadence.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 昨日、俺、発熱で、学校、休んだぜ、桜、お前、心配して、メッセージ、くれてさ、ありがとうな、本当に、嬉しい。
lines.en: Yesterday when I was sick with that fever and had to skip school — you sent me a message. You were worried about me. Thank you for that. It meant a lot.
lines.style: Quiet gratitude. Opens simply. Slight hesitation before 'you were worried' — vulnerability breaking through. The 'thank you' is understated, all the feeling underneath.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 最近の音楽、今ひとつ、ハマれないんだよね、リク、お前、おすすめ、ある?教えて、新しいの、聞きたい。
lines.en: I just can't seem to get into the music that's popular right now. Do you have any recommendations? I want to hear something new.
lines.style: Casual opening, genuine question underneath. Slight frustration on 'can't seem to.' Brightens on the ask — she's trusting his taste. Leaning in.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 苦い味のお菓子、お前、平気だっけ?俺、ちょっと、苦手なんだ、桜、お前、強いよな、味覚、本当に、すごい。
lines.en: Those bitter sweets — you can handle them, right? I'm not so great with that flavor myself. You've always had a stronger palate than me. It's kind of impressive, actually.
lines.style: Light, almost teasing opening. Genuine observation wrapped in self-deprecation. On 'stronger palate,' real appreciation surfaces — not a put-down, an actual compliment.
